W: Hello, matthew. It's been such a long time since we last saw each other. From what I heard, you found work at an international food chain based in New York. How do you like working there?

M: Great. Actually, I haven't had much free time since I was promoted to a managerial position last month, but I really like my coworkers.

W: Good to hear that. You know, I need to find a job myself since I'm graduating from grad school in the fall. Do you happen to know if your company is hiring these days?

M: I'm not quite sure. But I can ask someone in HR if you want
data.transcriptViHtml:
Người phụ nữ: Chào Matthew. Đã lâu rồi chúng ta không gặp nhau. Tớ nghe nói cậu đã tìm được việc ở một chuỗi cửa hàng thực phẩm quốc tế có trụ sở tại New York. Cậu cảm thấy thế nào khi làm việc ở đó?

Matthew: Tuyệt lắm. Thực ra, tớ không có nhiều thời gian rảnh kể từ khi được thăng chức lên vị trí quản lý vào tháng trước, nhưng tớ rất thích các đồng nghiệp của mình.

Người phụ nữ: Nghe thật vui. Cậu biết không, tớ cũng đang cần tìm việc vì tớ sẽ tốt nghiệp cao học vào mùa thu này. Cậu có biết công ty của cậu hiện tại có đang tuyển dụng không?

Matthew: Tớ không chắc lắm. Nhưng nếu cậu muốn, tớ có thể hỏi ai đó ở phòng nhân sự cho cậu.

Giải thích: Đoạn hội thoại là cuộc trò chuyện giữa hai người bạn lâu ngày gặp lại. Người phụ nữ hỏi thăm về công việc mới của Matthew và nhờ anh ấy hỏi giúp về cơ hội việc làm tại công ty của anh. Matthew vừa được thăng chức nên khá bận, nhưng anh ấy sẵn sàng giúp bạn mình tìm hiểu thông tin tuyển dụng.

data.transcriptHtml: Good morning, everyone. My name is Paul. Young and I'll be leading today's staff meeting. The first thing on our agenda today is the replacement of our service elevator, which is currently out of order. Temporarily, workers are using the main elevators in the building, but this may inconvenience our customers. As you know, the service elevator has already stopped working three times this week and it seems like it's beyond repair. Thus, I think it's necessary to replace it. It's been almost 10 years since it was installed. In addition, we have had trouble moving heavy objects like desks and tables because our current elevator's capacity is limited. What's worse, it is too slow to keep up with our needs. For these reasons, I went ahead and called the elevator firm this morning, and asked them to send someone over for an estimate. I'll keep you updated on this matter via email.

As you probably know, our company is planning to release a new product next year and we'd like to hear from prospective customers like you to develop a marketing strategy. Dear Directors,
In response to changing publication trends, I offer the following agenda to discuss at the directors' meeting next Monday.
Our sales department reports that sales of Fishing Monthly in print edition have been drastically declining over the past couple of years and have actually dropped by 40% this year. Since print publication rates are diminishing and electronic publication rates are rising, we also have to consider turning our sights on electronic publication.
There is statistical evidence that electronic publishing provides wider dissemination, and a number of journals have already established electronic versions or even moved entirely to electronic publication. Electronic publishing will cut down production and shipping costs and attract more readers at a reduced price and with better accessibility. In addition, the government offers subsidies for green publishing to companies which adopt a publishing process to minimize the impact on the environment by using digital or print-on-demand technology.
Given these facts, I'd like us to start thinking about ways to promote Fishing Monthly's online edition and reduce the print edition by at least 50% next year. In order to cut down on print publishing, we might have to shut down some of our production plants. This surely is not an easy decision. However, given the current business climate, I feel these changes are absolutely essential to succeed in the coming year and beyond.
I look forward to discussing this and other issues involving the magazine with all of you on Monday.
Reed

3124 Kipt Avenue, New Kensington PA

To whom it may concern,
I am writing about the DMP5 I purchased on September 14 at your retail outlet in Forest Hills. It features an electronic dictionary and an MP3 player. I spoke to the salesperson, whose name is Michael Robertson, at length about my needs and told him that I was interested in durability rather than functions. He said he carried the DMP4 for $500 and the DMP5 for $600. I knew that the DMP4 was renowned for its durability. Mr. Robertson assured me that the DMP5 had recently come out with more functions and would hold up as well, if not better than the DMP4.
On Mr. Robertson's recommendation, I purchased the DMP5 and, upon receipt, he informed me that should I have a problem with it, I could exchange it for a new model as long as it was in the original packaging. Since GNet Inc. is not based locally, it would take too long to transport it to and from the maintenance department at your headquarters for processing. To save time, the retailer where I purchased the item said he would exchange it for a new one and send it back himself.
However, after one month of use, I found the protective cover has been ineffective in protecting it from other objects in my bag, which caused the initial programming and operating problems. I am aware that it is not in its original packaging, but I still have the receipt. When explaining this to Mr. Robertson, he stated that I am not entitled to an exchange and should contact the company directly. Since the DMP5 was purchased on your retailer's recommendation, I would like to ask for an exchange.
I'd greatly appreciate it if this issue could be rectified immediately.

Sincerely,
Kim Severson

East Oaks Hotel has 93,000 square feet of event space, consisting of banquet facilities, conference/meeting rooms, a ballroom, and exhibit space. We also offer a roundtrip airport shuttle at scheduled times. Business services, wedding services, and tour/ticket assistance are available as well.

Hey Chris,
I hope preparations for the concert are going well! I was told by the concert hall manager that the hall will be available on the 4th, 8th and 21st of next month. I didn't give him a final answer because I wasn't sure how much time you need to rehearse.
As you know, this will be one of the most important concerts for your band, as it's the first one since the release of your last album two years ago. Since you've decided to perform more concerts than make another album, this first concert should really be something special.
Personally, I thought that the 8th would be the best as long as it gives you enough time to rehearse. I think the 4th would be a little too early. The 21st would be okay, but I'm just not sure because Marine Force is putting on a concert on the 23rd. Thus, I think that would take away some people who would go to your concert.
Get back to me as soon as possible so I can finalize the schedule with the concert hall staff. Thanks.

Dave

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Han's First Concert in Two Years

The hottest news in the music industry lately is the Han's first concert in two years. Two years ago, Han's, one of the most popular rock bands, expressed its intention to focus on concerts instead of recording any new albums.
After two years, fans are finally able to see them again. However, critics are expressing a few concerns about the band.
Firstly, why hasn't the band performed for the past two years? Two years seems like a long time for their fans.
Secondly, while Han's has been off the radar, other new bands such as Marine Force have quickly risen to the top of the charts. More importantly, Han's and Marine Force will be performing only two days apart. This will cause an inevitable competition between the two top bands.
As much as fans have been waiting for Han's concert, it better satisfy fans' expectations in order to keep them away from Marine Force.
